_comment: Free-text FAQ passages that are not modelled as frames. They are indexed in the vector store and used as a semantic-retrieval fallback. Structured FAQ entries are generated automatically from the knowledge base (see chatbot/faq_builder.py).

faqs.question: Is the campus ragging free? What is the anti-ragging policy?
faqs.answer: AI University has zero tolerance for ragging. An anti-ragging committee and squad monitor the campus and hostels 24x7, and students can report incidents anonymously on the helpline 1800-180-5522.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi internet available on campus and in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Yes. The entire campus, including hostels and the library, has 1 Gbps Wi-Fi. Every student gets a personal login.

faqs.question: Is lateral entry available for diploma holders into second year B.Tech?
faqs.answer: Yes. Diploma holders with at least 60% can join the second year of B.Tech through lateral entry. About 10% of seats in each branch are reserved for lateral entry.

faqs.question: Is there an NRI or management quota for admission?
faqs.answer: Yes. 15% of seats are available under the NRI / management quota. The fee for these seats is 1.5 times the regular tuition fee.

faqs.question: Do students get internships during the course?
faqs.answer: Yes. An internship of at least 8 weeks is compulsory in the third year of B.Tech and in the second year of PG programmes. The placement cell helps students find internships.

faqs.question: Is there a canteen or food court on campus?
faqs.answer: The campus has a central food court and three canteens serving South Indian, North Indian and Chinese food from 7:30 AM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is there a medical facility or doctor on campus?
faqs.answer: A health centre with a full-time doctor and nurse is open 24x7, and an ambulance is always available. The university also has a tie-up with a nearby multi-speciality hospital.

faqs.question: Is there a dress code or uniform for students?
faqs.answer: There is no uniform. Students must wear formal clothes on Mondays and during lab sessions, and must always carry their ID card.

faqs.question: Are there international exchange or study abroad programmes?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI University has semester-exchange agreements with partner universities in Germany, Singapore and Australia for students with a CGPA above 8.0.

faqs.question: What is the fee refund policy if I cancel my admission?
faqs.answer: If you withdraw before the start of classes, the full fee is refunded minus Rs. 1,000 processing charges. After classes start, refunds follow the UGC refund guidelines.

faqs.question: What is the minimum attendance required to write exams?
faqs.answer: Students need at least 75% attendance in each course to be allowed to write the semester examinations.

faqs.question: What clubs and extracurricular activities are there?
faqs.answer: There are more than 30 student clubs, including coding, robotics, music, dance, drama, NSS, NCC and entrepreneurship. The annual cultural fest 'AIU Fest' is held every February.

faqs.question: Can I get an education loan? Does the university help with bank loans?
faqs.answer: Yes. The university has tie-ups with SBI, Indian Bank and Canara Bank for education loans, and the accounts office issues the fee-structure letter needed by the bank.

faqs.question: What is the pattern of the GUET entrance exam? What syllabus?
faqs.answer: GUET is a 2-hour computer-based test with 120 multiple-choice questions on Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (12th standard syllabus). There is no negative marking.

faqs.question: How does the counselling and seat allotment work?
faqs.answer: Seats are allotted in order of entrance rank during counselling. Candidates choose a branch from the seats still available, and documents are verified at the same time.
